svg.aria-label: I am a BSc Computer Science student at the University of Ghana (expected graduation: 2028), based in Accra. I enjoy building practical tools, mostly in Python and JavaScript, and I am focusing on software engineering and Python development. I build projects to learn how real software works: calling APIs, handling errors, writing tests and deploying what I make. Over time I want to move towards AI engineering.
